title: itembank source locator sidecar
description: The frozen locator sidecar contract (Phase 14C, D-14C-1). A sidecar sits beside the derived Markdown a source adapter produced and records where every derived line came from in the original medium, so a citation naming a source_id, a fingerprint, and a span_id resolves back to a page, a slide, a cue, or a spine item without the citation shape changing. locators[].span_id joins to the span ids auditor.normalize_source assigns to the derived Markdown, which is what keeps exactly one parser true across every medium.

schema_version.description: This document's own schema version; must equal x-itembank-version.

source_id.description: The identity.new_object_id() of the derived Markdown source object this sidecar describes.

adapter.description: Which ADAPTER_REGISTRY entry produced this sidecar.

adapter_version.description: ADAPTER_VERSIONS[adapter] at extraction time, so a re-extraction by a changed adapter is visible.

fingerprint.description: identity.object_fingerprint(md_bytes, 'source'), the same value the journal entry records as after_fingerprint.

rights.description: The seven rights operations as recorded for this source. Unknown is restrictive, never permissive.

confidence.description: The adapter's own confidence in the extraction; null means not assessed. Advisory only: it never gates disclosure or scoring.

reading_order.description: Locator ids in document reading order.

locators.description: Every locator this adapter emitted. May be empty only when unsupported is non-empty.

unsupported.description: Every structure the adapter refused, by named code and message. A refusal is recorded, never silently dropped.

origin.description: The provenance of the raw bytes this source was derived from.

kind.description: Whether the bytes came from a file on an approved root or from a fetch.

value.description: The raw file's registry-relative path, or the URL that was fetched.

fetched_at.description: When the fetch happened; null for a local file.

http_etag.description: The response ETag, captured so a later re-fetch can tell whether the remote changed; null when absent.

http_last_modified.description: The response Last-Modified header; null when absent.

snapshot_rel_path.description: Where the captured snapshot was stored when snapshot storage is inline; null for reference-plus-cache and for a local file.

rights.description: The seven identity.RIGHTS_OPERATIONS, each independently granted, denied, or unknown. Read, quote, transform, remote_process, package, export, and share are separate grants and one never implies another.

read.description: The recorded state of the read right.

quote.description: The recorded state of the quote right.

transform.description: The recorded state of the transform right.

remote_process.description: The recorded state of the remote_process right.

package.description: The recorded state of the package right.

export.description: The recorded state of the export right.

share.description: The recorded state of the share right.

unsupported_entry.description: One structure the adapter refused, named rather than dropped.

code.description: A named source.* refusal code from SOURCE_ADAPTER_CODES.

message.description: A plain-sentence explanation naming what was refused and why.

locator.description: One addressable structure in the original medium, joined to the derived Markdown by span_id.

id.description: The short reading-order id, in the shapes the locator-fidelity gold cases already use: p1.0, p1.c1.0, t.r0c0, hdr1, fn1.0.

span_id.description: The auditor.normalize_source span id of the derived Markdown line this locator maps to, literally sp-N; null only when the locator maps to no derived line.

kind.description: The frozen union vocabulary of structure kinds across every medium.

body.description: The per-medium locator body, discriminated by its required medium const.

body_markdown.description: A locator into derived Markdown produced by an identity adapter.

line.description: One-based line number in the derived Markdown.

body_pdf.description: A locator into a PDF page.

index.description: Zero-based index of the structure within the page, in reading order.

column.description: Zero-based column index when column detection ran; null when it did not. Column detection arrives in plan 14C-02.

bbox.description: The [x0, top, x1, bottom] bounding box in PDF user space, or null when the extractor reported no geometry.

body_docx.description: A locator into a WordprocessingML part.

part.description: Which document part the paragraph lives in.

paragraph_index.description: Zero-based paragraph index within that part.

ref_id.description: The relationship or note id when the part is referenced rather than inline; null otherwise.

body_pptx.description: A locator into a PresentationML slide.

shape_index.description: Zero-based shape index within the slide, in reading order.

notes.description: True when the text came from the slide's notes part rather than the slide itself.

body_epub.description: A locator into an EPUB spine item.

spine_index.description: Zero-based position in the spine reading order.

spine_idref.description: The spine item's idref from the OPF manifest.

element_index.description: Zero-based index of the block element within the spine item.

fragment.description: The element's id attribute, usable as a URL fragment; null when it has none.

body_web.description: A locator into a fetched web page, carrying both a structural and a textual anchor so one surviving the other still resolves.

css_selector.description: A CSS selector addressing the element in the captured snapshot.

text_quote.description: A W3C-style text-quote anchor: the exact text plus its surrounding context.

body_transcript.description: A locator into a timed transcript cue.

cue_index.description: Zero-based cue index in the transcript file.

body_ocr.description: A locator into OCR output. bbox and confidence are typed strictly null on purpose: scripts/ocr_lib.py returns flat transcribed text with no coordinates and no confidence score, so this schema makes a fabricated bounding box invalid rather than trusting an adapter not to invent one. A structured-output OCR mode that measures geometry is a schema_version bump and a recorded migration, never a loosened type.

bbox.description: Always null. See this definition's description.

confidence.description: Always null. See this definition's description.
